title: Restructure primitives: spacing token scoping, auto-layout axis fixes, and publish gating for chart/table components
creator: Asha Ramesh
description: Goal: Reduce fragility in the Figma library by scoping spacing tokens to component primitives, repairing incorrect auto-layout axes for table and chart atoms, and introducing a gating checklist for library publishes that affect chart/table variants. Motivation: Recent regressions from token collisions and flipped auto-layout axes caused visual density changes in the console charts and table rows. This ticket coordinates design decisions, a small migration script for renaming tokens, and a publish checklist that product/engineering must sign off on before a library release.
acceptance_criteria: All spacing tokens used by primitives (button, table-row, chart-axis, chip) are scoped with a clear prefix (e.g., spacing.core.* or spacing.component.*) and documented in the token inventory.
Auto-layout axes for affected table and chart components are corrected (horizontal vs vertical constraints) without changing visual spacing in current screens — verified across responsive frames.
A publish gating checklist (design review, QA snapshot, PR link, release notes) is attached to the Figma library file and used for the next two publishes.
No regressions shown in the nightly visual diff dashboard for the chart and table route after token migration and axis fixes.
Design tokens migration plan and a rollback strategy are recorded and approved by PM and Eng.
A brief partner-facing note is prepared for platform teams describing API/SDK implications if any (e.g., CSS token mapping changes).
work_items: Audit current spacing token usage across top 25 frames that touch charts/tables
Create namespacing convention and update token inventory doc
Author token-rename migration script (reference naming map) and run locally against a duplicate library for validation
Fix auto-layout axis and constraint misconfigurations for table-row and chart-axis components; create regression frames
Create publish gating checklist and attach to Figma library as a page; update team handbook
Coordinate a small QA run with Solutions Eng to validate in a staging workspace
Prepare PRD-lite notes & changelog entry for console-frontend and design system releases
